previous.changeLog:
Improved in-battle percentage prediction.
The Progress Bar section now has its own visibility switches.
Both centre bars can now be drawn 1.5x as tall and twice as wide.
The fade in / hold / fade out can be turned off entirely under Transitions, separately for automatic appearances and for Alt peeks.
Reorganized settings a bit.

current.changeLog:
Move the centre bar wherever you want. Ctrl+drag it mid-battle, with the bar on screen, and it stays there.
Hold Duration (s) under Transitions — how long the bar lingers before fading.
An ETA to your next mark on the Moving Average bar: its next-mark caption now also shows how many more battles you need at your current pace.
The Moving Average bar's lower end now follows your projected average instead of the mark you already hold.
Large is a more moderate step up from the default.

previous.changeLog:
Version 1.0.8 comes with reverted back turret and gun instant synchronization with responsive reticle movement (it was removed for optimisations).

It has been given back at the cost of 25 microseconds (negligible cost), but now gun model exactly follows responsive reticle.
User requested to revert it back and I find it a valid exception of optimisation rule.
Also comes with small change, that slows down tick-rate when there are no reticles present (for example: during artillery strike in Onslaught)

current.changeLog: Version 1.0.9 comes with enabled responsive reticle for SPG in arcade view(top-down view still is disabled) and fix for stuttering gun model when playing SPG

previous.changeLog:
Version 3.1.8 comes with:
* adjustment to changes of Responsive Reticle mod in version 1.0.5
* reduced mod performance overhead by 30% on average (that's 40% faster code!)
* refactored few annoying code fragments

IMPORTANT: If you use this mod together with Responsive Reticle mod, you MUST update Responsive Reticle mod to version 1.0.5 as well.
Otherwise Dispersion Reticle won't properly react to reticle responsiveness.

Also - using both together, reduces performance overhead by whooping 75% (that's 4x faster code!).

current.changeLog: Version 3.1.9 comes with fix for errors during top-down view when playing SPG with Responsive Reticle mod
